visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a grey t-shirt with orange lettering on the back walks toward a food stall in a busy market environment. The stall has a large orange and red sign with Chinese characters. Passers-by are visible in the background, including a woman with a ponytail in a white shirt. (2) Close-up of a worker wearing a black headband, black mask, and black gloves shredding light green papaya over a pile of orange carrots and purple cabbage in a glass display case. Bright overhead lights illuminate the vibrant colors of the vegetables. (3) The worker uses metal tongs to mix shredded papaya, purple cabbage, and sliced onions in a large stainless steel bowl. They add sliced cherry tomatoes and red chilies. A background of various prepared ingredients and jars of sauce is visible. (4) A metal ladle pours a reddish-orange sauce into the bowl. The worker continues mixing the ingredients vigorously with tongs, ensuring even coating. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the wet texture of the sauce. (5) The worker transfers the mixed salad into a clear plastic bag using tongs. Another worker in a grey apron is visible in the background preparing other orders. (6) A close-up shot shows a hand holding the top of a plastic bag filled with the papaya salad, which includes large cooked shrimps and shredded chicken. The bag is tied with a red string. The background is a bright, out-of-focus outdoor street scene. (7) A pair of chopsticks picks up a single large, pink cooked shrimp from the salad, followed by a cluster of shredded chicken. The ingredients are glistening with sauce. (8) A hand pours roasted peanuts from a small plastic zip-bag into the salad bowl. The salad contains green herbs and sliced onions. (9) A different bag is held up, containing yellowish-green sliced papaya mixed with passion fruit seeds and a single large, dark dried plum. The lighting is bright natural daylight. (10) Chopsticks pick up a thin, translucent slice of the passion fruit papaya. (11) Final shot of the market stall with a large text overlay providing the store's address and contact information.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 你知道高雄德民市場. (2) [Subtitle]: 有一攤夏天才吃得到的涼拌青木瓜嗎?. (3) [Subtitle]: 老闆娘一週只賣四天. (4) [Subtitle]: 而且賣完就收攤. (5) [Subtitle]: 想吃真的要早點去. (6) [Subtitle]: 新鮮的青木瓜絲. (7) [Subtitle]: 拌入十多種辛香料特製的醬汁. (8) [Subtitle]: 酸甜香辣 爽口又開胃. (9) [Subtitle]: 辣度還能依喜好調整. (10) [Subtitle]: 我們是選微辣. (11) [Subtitle]: 推薦你們直接點小辣以上. (12) [Subtitle]: 想吃更豐富可以選雙拼. (13) [Subtitle]: 有紮實鮮蝦和雞肉絲. (14) [Subtitle]: 加上洋蔥絲 紫高麗菜絲. (15) [Subtitle]: 番茄和東南亞香菜. (16) [Subtitle]: 還有香脆花生. (17) [Subtitle]: 口感香氣很有層次. (18) [Subtitle]: 一定要試試百香果青木瓜. (19) [Subtitle]: 冰涼酸甜 果香濃郁. (20) [Subtitle]: 買回家稍微冷凍一下更消暑. (21) [Subtitle]: 你們快去吃吃看. (22) [Subtitle]: 我們是虎麗笑嗨嗨. (23) [Subtitle]: 下次再一起吃美食囉. (24) [Logo]: 虎麗笑嗨嗨. [Slogan]: 泰式涼拌青木瓜 德民黃昏市場 (一街6號) 高雄市楠梓區德民路977號.
